patterns.note: A persistent, content-rich left sidebar provides detailed product information and navigation, remaining sticky while the main content area scrolls independently.
Full-width sections with generous vertical padding create clear content separation, often featuring large, impactful imagery or bold typography.
A primary palette of deep blues and white is contrasted with vibrant, high-saturation pink-to-purple gradient imagery, creating a modern and luxurious feel.
Large, light-weight sans-serif headings with ample letter spacing are used for impact, especially in hero and key section titles.

Sections reveal with a subtle fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport, enhancing content discovery. The hero background image exhibits a slight parallax effect relative to the foreground text.

technique_notes: The main content area scrolls vertically while a dedicated left sidebar and top navigation remain fixed, creating a split-screen information display. Scroll-triggered animations (likely using AOS or GSAP) are used to reveal new sections with a gentle fade-in or slide-up as they become visible in the viewport. The hero image features a subtle parallax effect where the background moves slower than the foreground content during scroll.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, light-weight sans-serif headings (~4-5x body) with generous letter spacing, creating an airy and impactful hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle: buttons and interactive elements have slightly rounded corners.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy: generous vertical padding between sections and ample whitespace around content, especially in the hero area.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the persistent, content-rich left sidebar that remains sticky throughout the scroll, providing continuous access to detailed product information and safety warnings. This, combined with the bold, high-contrast, gradient-heavy imagery, creates a unique blend of editorial depth and modern visual appeal.
